evals.prompt: In this new TanStack Start app, add a projects list page for signed-in users with pagination in the URL and data from our Postgres database.
expectations: Detects the installed @tanstack/react-start version and existing conventions before creating files
Puts DB access in a server-only file (*.server.ts or import-protected) and exposes it through createServerFn with .validator(), not .inputValidator()
Validates page/search params with validateSearch and passes them through loaderDeps
Gates the route with a pathless layout beforeLoad redirect and still authorizes inside the server function
Keeps the route file thin (no DB calls or business rules in it)

evals.prompt: Review this route: its loader reads process.env.API_KEY and calls a third-party API directly. Also there is a QueryClient exported from src/lib/query.ts.
expectations: Explains that loaders run in the browser on client navigation
Moves the secret read and API call into a createServerFn handler
Moves QueryClient creation into getRouter() with setupRouterSsrQueryIntegration
Recommends checking the client build output for the secret

evals.prompt: Add global logging middleware to our TanStack Start app.
expectations: Registers request middleware with createStart in src/start.ts (not registerGlobalMiddleware)
Adds createCsrfMiddleware for server functions because creating src/start.ts removes the default

evals.prompt: Our TanStack Start app mounts Elysia on /api/$ and uses Eden. Add an endpoint to rename a project and use it from the project page; SSR must show the signed-in user's projects.
expectations: Adds the operation to the Elysia app (validated with its schemas, authorized from the session) instead of a new createServerFn
Calls it through the isomorphic Eden client; the server side forwards the request cookies and the browser side uses the page origin
Does not return the Eden proxy directly from an async function
Protects the cookie-authenticated write against CSRF (Start's CSRF middleware does not cover Elysia routes)
Invalidates the owning query or router data after the mutation

evals.prompt: Restructure the App Router folders of this Next.js 16 project.
expectations: Does not apply TanStack Start conventions to a Next.js project
